hotspots.sample_limitation: one migration window; this is not longitudinal churn

ownership.source: manifest-owned manual paths plus L9 hotspot/seam decisions

identity_normalization.metric_owner: generated outcome, excluded from source-scattering score
retained identity, removed only with reviewed absorption evidence

review_triggers.when: a stable adaptation ID gains a second manual outcome or a new manual path
review_triggers.action: require hotspot/seam review with manifest path ownership

review_triggers.when: generated output changes without declared source inputs
review_triggers.action: reject until deterministic generator/provenance evidence is recorded

review_triggers.when: a policy adaptation changes block acceptance, script, serialization, or consensus parameters
review_triggers.action: block review and require consensus-boundary evidence
review_triggers.invariant: RDTS/BIP110 enforcement remains absent and local policy remains outside block validity

review_triggers.when: a proposed seam combines unrelated adaptation IDs solely to shrink a file or line count
review_triggers.action: reject and retain separate ownership records

interpretation_rules: Use review triggers, never hard limits.
Absorption, security work, modularization, moved modules, and evidence evolution require an explained baseline change.
Do not reward line-count compression, consensus movement, hidden generated churn, or unrelated-unit aggregation.
